'''Trogan''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located within the [[Trogan system/Legends|Trogan system]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], known for its strong tides, natural beauty, terrible weather, and lush vegetation springing from desolate wasteland. The planet's residents hoped to turn it into a tourist attraction, in order to compete with rival [[Berchest/Legends|Berchest]], but despite spectacular [[Ocean/Legends|oceanic]] activity, the hoped-for tourism never materialized, and the planet's economy stagnated at a subsistence level.

==History==
Originally known as '''Ethullum''', it was absorbed into [[Xim's empire]] as [[Xim/Legends|he]] expanded his borders from the [[Kingdom of Cron]].<ref name="TEA" /> Trogan had been considered a Lost Throne of Xim the Despot, specifically [[Wyndigal 2|Huronom]], before being disproven.<ref name="Xim Week">{{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-extra-the-history-of-xim-and-the-tion-cluster|text=Essential Atlas Extra: The History of Xim and the Tion Cluster|int=Xim Week: The History of Xim and the Tion Cluster}}</ref>

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Trogan was located within [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] space.<ref name="TEA" /> It eventually joined the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="TLCSB" /> The planet was still controlled by the Empire during the [[Thrawn campaign]] and was where the [[Smugglers' Alliance]] [[Ambush on Trogan|formed]].<ref name="TLC" />
